articleTitle: Space-time radio reception as the system of mass service
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: It has been demonstrated the possibility of application system mass service for estimation parameters of space-time radio reception system.

articleTitle: Limit cycles in PI control loops with absolute deadband sampling
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Absolute deadband sampling is used in discrete control systems for reduction of the number of produced events. Under proper conditions, this sampling type results in limit cycles in steady state, which lead to increased number of events and deteriorate the sampling efficiency. This paper investigates the condition of emergence of limit cycles in the closed control loops with PI controllers, as well as the frequency of limit cycles.

articleTitle: Relativistic magnetron of millimiter waveband
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The first experimental study of relativistic 8 mm magnetron with diffraction microwave output has been carried out. Experiment and simulation data have been compared.

articleTitle: A new approach for non-linear analysis of power amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper presents a new approach for non-linear analysis of power amplifiers based on the n-order polynomial modelling. A general expression for the fundamental frequency output is developed in this paper. It allows considering any order of polynomial model and obtaining analytical expression for the fundamental-frequency output without complex computations, using developed formulas. This model significantly simplifies non-linear analysis of power amplifiers and the process of designing linearizers. This paper also presents a simple approach for obtaining polynomial model from a frequency response of power amplifier. The proposed method is verified by experiments. Obtained polynomial model shows simulation results similar to the measurements for real amplifier. Developed n-order output modelling and proposed model extraction method can significantly simplify, optimize and enhance power amplifierspsila non-linear analysis and behavioural modelling. Proposed modelling approach can be also used to design linearizers.

articleTitle: Inaccuracy estimation of microwave microstrip reflect array implementation
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The work presents the results of simulation of microstrip reflect arrays. The calculations were made with automated system (CAD system) CST Microwave Studio. The equivalent unit cell waveguide approach was applied to make phase curves calculation for the unit patches. The influence of angular displacement of subarrays of the antenna was considered.

articleTitle: Autodyne millimeter-wave FMCW radar
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of investigations of 8-mm band FMCW autodyne radar are given in this work. The radar intended for speed and range measurement of objects. Self-detection autodyne transmitter is made on base of Gann diode with varactor tuning. Digital methods of radiating signal forming and spectral signal processing and digital filtering of difference frequency signal are realized in the radar. Autodyne radar potential is not less 85 dB having output power of about 25 mW. Resolution on distance at the tuning band of 500 MHz is 0.6 m and range measurement accuracy 0.3 m. Dimensions of the radar are 92times92times166 mm. Mass is 0.35 Kg.

articleTitle: Radiation of UWB pulses by antenna array systems with interactive elements
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The method of calculation of a spectrum and the form of the UWB pulses radiated by antenna with interactive elements is developed. The method is based on the frequency dependence of effective resistance.

articleTitle: Self-exciting single-cavity gyromultiplier
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A new scheme of self-exciting single-cavity gyromultiplier is tested in a preliminary mm-range experiment. Such a scheme is prospective for realization in THz range.

articleTitle: The microstrip antenna
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The microstrip antenna with circular polarization characteristics have been presented. The antenna includes rectangular circular with auxiliary microstrip resonators with relative length.

articleTitle: Reversal magnetization process in the monocrystalline samples of strontium hexaferrites
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The high-frequency and static processes of reversal magnetization are experimentally investigated in the single-crystal specimens of strontium hexaferrites (SrFe<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">19</sub>). Good coincidence of dynamic and static dependences has been obtained at the transition from homogeneous (saturated) in the domain state.

articleTitle: Highly doped nanostrcturized template of anodic alumina
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A highly doped template of porous anodic alumina with carbon atoms content up to 40 per cent or even more was prepared for the first time by electrochemical aluminium anodization in aqueous malonic acid solutions, containing the arsenazo I chelating agent.

articleTitle: UWB wireless communications with signal correlation processing
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In recent years Ultra Wide Band (UWB) noise technology has received attractive attention for the best electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) and low probability of interception (LPI) performances. UWB signals are used at short distance wireless communications in the 3.1-10.6 GHz frequency region and transmission of sensor data [1-3]. UWB noise continuous wave-forms provide secure wireless communications because they cannot be detected by means of traditional receivers [2-3]. In the present paper we discuss the results of numerical analysis of data rate, error probability and security performances for wireless noise communications with correlation signal processing.

articleTitle: Micro wave GaAs MIC discrete phase shifters of C-band with inbuilt control driver
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The work provides an example of microwave (MW) GaAs MIC discrete phase shifter based on switching filters with the regard to gained experience of design and manufacturing of similar MIC for different frequency bands.

articleTitle: Diagnostics of the troposphere refraction by means of the radio settings of the satellites
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Proposes a method of estimation of land troposphere refraction using radio setting of navigation satellites of the GPS. Presented design ratio that tie together satellite viewing angle and effective gradients of refraction coefficient in raying troposphere layer is obtained for the equivalent of an Earth radius model. The results of calculation are compared to experimental data which were obtained by satellite setting angles.

articleTitle: Scattering and absorbing of electromagnetic radiation by very thin metal wires
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The scattering and absorbing of electromagnetic radiation by very thin metal wires was investigated. The NiCr and Pt wire (diameter 15 mum) was placed in rectangular waveguide with wave H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</sub>. The extinction and reflection from wire was measured, and the efficiency factors of scattering and absorbing was calculated. The measuring was doing in frequency range 3...18 GHz (the wave-length in waveguide was 2...28 cm). The cross-sections of scattering and absorbing were increased with increasing of wave-length and were reached of values, which were in several hundreds more than diameter of wires.

articleTitle: Combinational frequencies excitation in dematron
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The output signal spectral compositions of the direct wave M-type amplifier with the cathode in the space of interaction and the opened electronic beam in case of amplification of the polyharmonical signal are investigated.

articleTitle: Circuits of combined absorptive filters
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Absorptive filters with good selectivity and low input reflection are designed. It is the most efficient to use designed filters as combination with reflective band-pass filters.

articleTitle: An open resonator for measurements of the strongly absorbing substances
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Bubnov-Galerkin method is applied for simulation of electromagnetic processes in open resonator exited by open circular waveguide located in the center of plane reflector; the second reflector has the spherical shape. The obtained results are promising for application of proposed resonant cell for the study of electromagnetic properties of materials with high losses.

articleTitle: C-X & K-band wideband MMIC amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In the present article a development and practical realization results of two types C-X & K-band wideband MMIC amplifiers are presented. The design and manufacturing techniques are considered. The experimental characteristics are shown.

articleTitle: Radiation effects in bipolar and CMOS integrated microcircuits
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of experimental researches and methods of prediction of radiation resistance of bipolar analog, and also logic CMOS integrated microcircuits are submitted at influence of gamma-radiation Co<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">60</sup>.

articleTitle: Designing of printed reflectarray with the use of phase synthesis
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The method of synthesis of printed reflectarrays with special form of radiation pattern is represented.

articleTitle: Mobile phones and health: The key role of human body fluids in bioeffects of non-thermal EM radiation
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: It is shown that an impact of the weak EM radiation on people leads supposedly to the next sequence of events: EM radiation rarr modulation of an organism biological EM field rarr accumulation of energy and information in human body fluids rarr change of the functional activity of cells and organismrarr disease. A phenomenon of accumulation of mobile phone radiation in distilled water has been studied experimentally.

articleTitle: The model of multithread routing for broadband digital networks with integral service
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Proposed in this paper is the model of multithread routing for broadband digital networks with integral service based on the principle of searching the shortest way between commutation centers. The model meets QoS demands.

articleTitle: Microwave-based semiconductor ionizing radiation detectors
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In this paper basic restrictions of the existing semiconductor radiation detectors are analyzed. It is shown practicability of the radiation semiconductor detector using microwave technology development. Theoretical analysis of signal generation in such detectors is resulted and the factors limiting sensitivity and power resolution are estimated. Presented in this paper are some variants of ionizing radiation semiconductor detectors design, which are different by resonator structure of the microwave feed and signal generation circuit.

articleTitle: Control of the bandwidth of the microwave photonic structure in ferromagnetic resonance region
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In this paper an effect of bandwidth suppression in photonic structure is described and illustrated by different ferrites as a “defect” plate. The theoretical explanation and analysis are given. The frequency shift of bandwidth of a photonic structure is shown. Possible applications of such structures are suggested.

articleTitle: 5-6 GHz band GaAs MMIC five bit digital attenuator
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of design of the MMIC of five-bit microwave frequency attenuator are presented. The attenuator is executed on a crystal of gallium arsenide with dimensions 2.6 times 1.6 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and provides in a strip of frequencies 5 - 6 GHz signal amplitude control in a band 0 - 31 dB with a step 1 dB and initial losses - 6 dB. Research of a channel resistance of the transistor made on two types of epitaxial structures is carried out.

articleTitle: Physical nature of the Smith-Purcell effect and its simulation
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The Smith-Purcell radiation theory is created taking into account the electron beam self-modulation on the harmonics of the BWO mode at the self-consistent problem definition. The diffraction radiation field amplitudes for different rf current harmonics are retrieved depending on task parameters.

articleTitle: Invistigation of excitation of multifrequency signal in amplitron
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: It is analyzed output characteristics of amplitron in case of amplifying multifrequency signal. The amplification and methods of reducing of parasitic signals are considered.

articleTitle: Measurement of displacement parameters for plane elements by the microwave method using neural network tecknologies
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Series of real experiments for obtaining of reliable data of displacement parameters of a plane object under testing by the microwave interference method using neural network technologies have been carried out. Two mathematical models of neural networks were generated. The first model was created for obtaining the quadratic law of a detector characteristic; the second one was for updating estimations of displacement parameters. The neural network application has reduced the error of estimations.

articleTitle: Millimeter wavelength range radiometers with a solid-state modulator-calibrator
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Features of the functional scheme and design of millimeter wave radiometers with a new device - a solid state modulator-calibrator using planar Schottky barrier diode microcircuit - are presented.

articleTitle: Effect of microwave treatment on the properties of Au-TiBx-Al-Ti-n-GaN ohmic contacts
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: We studied the effect of microwave irradiation (frequency of 2.45 GHz, irradiance of ~1.5 W/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) for 2-100 s on the characteristics of Au-TiB<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub>-Al-Ti-n-GaN contact structures. A correlation between the contact resistivity changes and wafer curvature was found. This indicates considerable effect of intrinsic stresses on contact resistivity. Relative spread of ohmic contact resistance values decreases with irradiation time. This may indicate local intrinsic stresses homogenization enhanced by microwave irradiation.

articleTitle: Parallel encoding-decoding of matroid error-correcting codes
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The algorithm of parallel encoding and decoding of the maximum distance separable matroid codes is proposed. The parity-check matrices with specific structures are applied for synthesis majority-logic circuits of locating and correcting errors. The parameterized VHDL-entities for implementation of the encoder and decoder are designed.

articleTitle: Numerical analysis and optimization of double avalanche region IMPATT diode
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The analysis and optimization of the avalanche diode structure that includes two avalanche regions have been realized on basis of the nonlinear model and special optimization procedure. The admittance and energy characteristics of this type of diode were analyzed in very wide frequency band. Output power level was optimized for the second frequency band near the 220 GHz.

articleTitle: Influence of defects on scattering properties of the resonant magnetodielectric spherical crystal
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Solution and analysis of the problem on scattering of the plane electromagnetic wave by the resonant magnetodielectric spherical crystal is considered.

articleTitle: The coupled resonances of multiple dielectric resonator structures in metal waveguides
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Presented in this paper are the results of theoretical analysis regarding natural oscillations of the systems with a number of coupled spherical dielectric resonators (DR) in flat and rectangular waveguides. It is demonstrated that these systems have frequency isolated high - Q coupling resonances, localized in the region of structure discontinuity. The phenomenon of pulses self-filtration in DR periodic structures is noted.

articleTitle: Requirements for interactive heterogeneous telecommunication 4G network resource for mobile subscribers
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A method of determination of required interactive heterogeneous telecommunications 4G network resource for mobile subscribers, which are moving in automobiles along an autobahn or in railway expresses, is considered in this article.

articleTitle: The cubic nonlinear theory of plasma-beam superheterodyne free electron laser of dopplertron type
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The multiharmonical cubic nonlinear theory of plasma-beam superheterodyne free electron laser of dopplertron type is constructed. The unusual retarded electromagnetic wave is used as a pumping wave. Multi-harmonious interaction of waves is taken into consideration. Analysis of the levels and mechanisms of saturation is carried out. It is found that prospects of practical use of the considered systems for generation of especially powerful electromagnetic signals of the mm-range could be rather promising.

articleTitle: Influence of low intensity alternating magnetic field on the physical features of sorghum germs
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: It has been discovered that under influence of a low-frequency magnetic field on the sorghum germs the decrease of its typical values of permittivity and dielectric losses tangent takes place. After stopping of magnetic field influence the permittivity during values and dielectric losses tangent return into initial state during ~2 hours.

articleTitle: Measurement of UHF-permittivity of liquid crystals in porous silicon
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Method of dielectric investigation of liquid crystals (LQ) confined into porous silicon (PSi) is described. Individuality technique for dielectric measurements consists oa using two type sensors, switching as a system elements in the microstrip resonance contour. The effective permittivity and molecular alignments of PSi with LQ (8CB) is determined in frequency range 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> - 5 times 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sup> MHz.

articleTitle: AlInGaN/GaN heterostructures with 2D electron gas and quantum wells for transistors and light emitting diodes
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: AlInGaN/GaN heterostructures with 2D electron gas and quantum wells were grown on Si substrates. Optical and electrical properties of the heterostructure were investigated; high electron mobility transistors (HEMT) and light emitting diodes (LED) were fabricated.

articleTitle: Band-pass tunable filter based on planar dielectric resonators
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: An X-band 2-pole filter based on uniplanar dielectric resonators (PDR) with ferroelectric tuning was designed and fabricated. PDRpsilas were chosen because of their high Q-factor and the rarefied spectrum of resonance mode frequencies. At frequency ~10.5GHz the filter displayed insertion losses not more than S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">21</sub>=-3dB in the bandwidth Deltaf=110 MHz. The frequency of tuning was DeltaF=420 MHz.

articleTitle: Use doppler radars for studying turbulence of air weights in storm clouds
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The method of estimation of the turbulent pulsations of the air weights velocity in the storm clouds by the spectrums of the scattered signals is produced in this project. Using the first moment of the characteristics of the scattered signal spectrum one can estimate shifted characteristics of the air stream, and using the second moment one can estimate velocity spread of the scatterers strictly connected with the dispersion of the stream fluctuations inside the cloud.

articleTitle: The lapse analysis of waveguide meter of electromagnetic materials parameters
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of analysis of waveguide meter of electromagnetic materials parameters based of short circuit waveguide are presented. Measurement conditions effect on definition accuracy of parameters of investigated material is observed.

articleTitle: Integrated design tools for combined LAN
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Nowadays high-performance combined wired and wireless LANs are of great importance for companies and organizations of any size. However, efficient remains a challenge, since existing design tools only provide limited and hardly integrated support. The CANDY project was launched in 2003 with the aim to improve this situation by proposing an integrated design methodology with extensive tool support for all network design sub-tasks. This paper illustrates the CANDY network design methodology by giving an overview of the integrated design approach and presenting two advanced algorithms for design of wireless local area networks.

articleTitle: Minimizing memory effects in OFDM transmitters using adaptive baseband equalization
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper presents a simple and effective approach for eliminating memory effects in OFDM transmitters. It uses advantages of OFDM systems to provide pre-compensation of the frequency-dependent distortions, which are results of the power amplifiers (PA) memory effects. The process of memory effects quantification is carried out in this paper by obtaining a frequency-dependent PA gain, phase shift and intermodulation products. The memory effects are eliminated at baseband using equalization of the IDFT signal. Implementation of the equalization procedure at baseband makes the process of minimizing memory effects simple and effective, because no additional RF components or feedback loops are used. Memory effects are compensated in DSP part using simple multiplication of the frequency-domain digital signal by coefficients, which are calculated adaptively for each OFDM sub-carrier frequency and input power. The approach is tested with Motorola MOSFET MRF9742 power amplifier model in Advanced Design System (ADS). Simulations show significant improvement in minimizing memory effects. Received constellation of the 16-QAM OFDM signal after implementing baseband pre-compensation technique looks alike ideal one, whereas without pre-compensation it shows high dispersion due to the presence of PA memory.

articleTitle: Application of complex technological optimization for monolithic microwave circuits designing
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The development problem of methods and features of complex technological optimization is considered, i.e. the interconnected choice of probability of activities of functions by party microwave MMIC per unit time, tolerance of output electrical quantities (function indexes), faultiness probability and guaranteed quality of party and individual samples of microwave MIC is put using existing technologies and without updating their structure and parameters.

articleTitle: The microwave device for displacement parameter and vibration measurements
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A breadboard model of the coaxial microwave resonator for displacement parameter and vibration measurement has been developed. The device has been realized in a form of a probe and can operate under various environmental conditions. Possibilities of the given device were investigated experimentally.

articleTitle: Approximation bending around power spectrum of a speech signal
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Algorithms of voice signal energy spectrum approximation are studied using Lagrange interpolation polynom and cubic splines. Errors of power spectral density mathematical model realization depending on a number of approximation nodes and calculation expenses are investigated.

articleTitle: Technology for formation of photonic crystals using UHF elastic wave interference
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Unorthodox technology for formation of photonic crystals using UHF elastic wave interference was developed. This technology does not require using of photolithography.

articleTitle: Synthesys of lumped- and distributed-element matching networks using the genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The synthesis of lumped- and distributed-element matching networks based on genetic algorithm (GA) is considered. GA-based approach to the synthesis of matching networks containing lumped and distributed elements is considered. The approach is implemented in GENESYN software tool providing perfect control over network configurations and element values. The synthesis of lumped-distributed matching networks is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Individual reliability prediction of heterostructure RTD and devices based upon IT
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Individual reliability prediction of heterostructure resonant tunneling diode (RTD) is considered; its heterostructure degradation is considered as the dominating factor that has effect on RTDpsilas output electrical characteristic and devices on its basis; the procedure of individual reliability prediction of heterostructure RTD and devices on its basis is offered.

articleTitle: Dielectric periodic structure for microwave energy extraction from relativistic magnetron
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Dielectric periodic structure is proposed to extract the microwave energy from an 8.4-mm relativistic magnetron. Simulations made by means of a 3D FDTD method reveal that this structure selects and transmits the fundamental frequency, and whereas it rejects the electromagnetic waves at harmonic frequencies.

articleTitle: Active phased array with wide angle scanning
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Wideband active phased array antennas with wide angle scanning (Deltathetas<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">CK</sub>=150deg) is considered.

articleTitle: Study of the improvement of the AuGeNi ohmic contacts to n-GaAs
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of the comparative analysis of the AuGeNi ohmic contacts parameters received by the different methods of deposition are presented, the opportunity of improvement of the contactspsila parameters by introduction diffusion barrier in the structure of metallization is shown, and also influence of sulphidic treatment of GaAs surface on characteristics of the ohmic contacts is studied.

articleTitle: Trends of development of telecommunication broadband radioaccess systems of a long-wave part of a millimeter band
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The modern status of broadband radio access systems of a long-wave part of a millimeter range for the mobile and fixed services is submitted, and also problems and directions of development of such radio systems are determined with the purpose of achievement of transfer rate of Gbit/s and more.

articleTitle: Ionizing radiation effects in microwave receive-amplifying modules
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Dose rate and total dose radiation effects in microwave modules are investigated using pulse X-ray accelerator and Co<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">60</sup> gamma source.

articleTitle: The description of influence of microwave radiation low-intensity on active transportation of substances through the cage membrane
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The qualitative description of influence of microwave radiation of low intensity on active transportation of substances through a cage membrane is offered. It is shown, that taking into account external microwave influence there is a reduction of speed of hydrolysis ATP and, accordingly, active transport of ions through a cage membrane.

articleTitle: About input impedance of wideband flat and folded dipoles
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Based on comparison with data calculated by HFSS software, there have been performed an analysis of reliability of simplified procedures for calculation of input impedance of split-type and folded dipoles with flat arms.

articleTitle: Study of the influence of low-intensity extremely high-frequency electromagnetic radiation on growth rate of solid Ehrlich carcinoma
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The influence of various regimens of low-intensity extremely high-frequency electromagnetic radiation (EHF EMR) on growth rate of solid Ehrlich carcinoma in mice was studied. A maximal anti-tumor efficacy of EHF EMR was found at the frequency of 42.2 GHz and exposure for 20 min daily during 5 consecutive days after tumor inoculation. The mechanisms of anti-tumor effects of EHF EMR are suggested to be connected with modification of the immune status of the organism.

articleTitle: The problem of ribbon electron beam modeling
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The three-dimensional model and algorithm of numeral calculation of electric field intensity is offered in a diode gun, and calculation of current density in the cross-sections of ribbon electron beam is carried out. The emission nonuniform, power and angular dispersion, electrons settling on electrodes are taken into account during calculations.

articleTitle: Linearization of power amplifiers by baseband digital predistortion for OFDM transmitters
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: For the signals with high peak-to-average ratio (PAR), such as WiMax OFDM, power amplifiers need to operate in a compression mode. It results in a nonlinear distortion of the output signal. To compensate for this distortion, linearizers are used. However, they decrease efficiency of amplifiers. This paper proposes to use a digital predistortion of baseband signals, which is characterized by a small impact on efficiency and a good linearizing performance, for linearization of OFDM transmitters. The paper describes design of a baseband predistorter and verifies its performances by WiMax OFDM simulations in ADS. Proposed predistorter brings significant improvements in AM/AM characteristic, eliminates spectrum re-growth, decreases adjacent channel power ratio (ACPR) and error vector magnitude (EVM).

articleTitle: Radiation stability of SOI and SOS CMOS LSI
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Comparative study of CMOS SRAM 8 K for different SOI structures (SIMOX, Smart-Cut and Dele-Cut) and SOS structures has been carried out. Radiation tests have been provided using laser and x-ray simulators in order to estimate CMOS SRAM stability to radiation pulse and total radiation dose. The tests have been carried out in active mode. The level of information safety for SRAM samples on SOI structures was three times higher than that for the samples on SOS structures. Research of the influence of total radiation dose has shown that the level was of 6middot10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup> units for SOS and SOI structures.

articleTitle: Measurement of dielectric substance characteristics by probe method of comparison
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The research method of substance electrodynamic characteristics is offered. The method is based on comparison of electrodynamic characteristics of resonators with specific substance and that under study. The method is applicable for analyses of dangerous, expensive and rare substances impossible by traditional methods.

articleTitle: Difraction radiation oscilator with multistage interaction space
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of theoretical investigation of the diffraction radiation oscillator (DRO) with two and three-stage interaction space in open resonant system (ORS) are presented. For this purpose the higher TEM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0nq</sub>-mode are excited in the ORS with n ldquospotrdquo along the interaction space. It is shown that the choice of a two-stage interaction space already allows lowering a starting current 1.91 times and improving selection of excited modes in DRO.

articleTitle: Magnetoresistive measuring converter of active power
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Principles of construction and parameters of thin film converters of active power in which the abnormal effect of the Hall and anisotropy magnetoresistance are considered.

articleTitle: Broadband power dividers for 0.5–18 GHz frequency band
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The power dividers for 8-18, 2-18 and 2-18 GHz were designed and manufactured. The power dividers contain coupled striplines to decrease number of resistors and reach low amplitude and phase unbalance and insertion loss. The additional strip is placed nearby a resistor. The resistor is better matched with striplines by this strip therefore developed power dividers have low VSWR and high Isolation of outputs.

articleTitle: Orotron on 1-mm wavelength on the second space harmonic
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology

abstract: The dynamic spectrum of radio emission is used for diagnostics of geo-affectivity of solar flares. The great number of hypotheses of its origin is published but all of them do not take into account the change of signal during its propagation through a corona. The presented analysis showed that the effects of propagation can form the dynamic spectrum containing zebra-patterns. The properties of designed spectrum coincide with basic properties of the observed spectrum. It is found out that a ldquospikerdquo structure of strips is a natural property of radio wave interference and its existence indicates the interference nature of formation of a zebra-pattern. Consequently the zebra pattern can be formed not in a source of emission, but can arise up as a result of radio wave propagation through the inhomogeneous refractive coronal medium.

publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The combined radio and optical observations of the active galactic nuclei were performed in the period from 2004 to 2006 years. The aim of our analysis was the detection of intraday variability and the search of possible correlation in radio and optical wavelenghts. The observations were conducted in CrAO (RT-22) at frequencies 22.2 and 36.8 GHz, and on the 1-m Zeiss-1000 reflector of the Special Astrophysical Observatory (SAO RAS). The instrument is equipped with CCD camera. The observations were performed in the R band. From 2004 to 2006 we performed five observing cycles, each by 7 – 10 nights, of the extragalactic nuclei 0133+476, 1633+382, 2134+004, 2145+067, 2251+158. In DA 55 and 2134+004 we detected the short time flux variations (0.2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</sup> on the scale of about 15 min) in R band. We find no significant fluctuations of the flux of the other sources. The significant radio flux variations were detected for 0133+476, 2134+004 (about 1.5 Jy on the scale 15 min), for 2145+067 (about 3 Jy on the scale 2 hours), for 2251+158 (about 2 – 2.5 Jy on the scale 0.5 hours). We did not detect any significant correlations of the optical and radio fluxes.

articleTitle: Antipodal slot line - numerical analysis

abstract: The antipodal slot line is the fundamental line for the many basic elements and functional units of microwave and EHF ranges. This analysis transmitted to Bubnov-Galerkin method with the use of the special basic functions. This procedure is not quite correct. In the paper the analysis of the antipodal slot line transmits the numerical grid method. The received results permitted to expand our knowledge about physics and parameters of the antipodal slot line.

articleTitle: Blazar 3C 454.3 - the 2004–2007 outburst in the optical and radio ranges
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: On the basis of experimental data obtained in the optical and radio ranges we carried out analysis of development of the flare phenomenon in blazar 3C 454.3 observed in 2004-2007. It was derived the detailed coincidence of the flare phenomenon for the optical and radio ranges with a time shift, which depends on the frequency of observations. The change in the delay of the flare phenomenon at frequencies of the radio range with respect to the optical range is in contrast to the dispersion delay of propagation of radiation in the interstellar medium and testifies to the internal cause of the phenomenon in question. Small-scale changes in the radiation flux in time intervals (5-10) days also correlate in the millimeter and optical ranges with nearly 10-month shift. It can serve as evidence in favor of a uniform source of initiation of radiation generation at all the wavelength ranges. Rapid fluctuations of radiation flux, which correlate with mentioned time shift in radio and optics, can be associated with matter inhomogeneities in the accretion disk. With detailed researches for fluctuations of AGN fluxes it is possible to create the procedure of analysis of the accretion disk structure. The model of energy release in active galactic nuclei (AGNs), not associated only with the accretion on the supermassive black holes, is proposed.

articleTitle: National system for seamen training and graduation in Ukraine

publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology

publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology

The influence of various errors on total error of antenna pointing is estimated.

publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology

publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The virtual cathode (VC) forming processes in the annular electron beam in the external magnetic field are numerically analyzed. It is shown that VC dynamics depends on relation between the external magnetic field and Brillouin magnetic field.

articleTitle: Estimation of the gap size influence on the coaxial resonant measuring converter output signals
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The model of a quarter wave coaxial microwave resonator measuring converter is presented and on its basis the complex of numerical experiments is carried out. The estimation of a gap influence on resonant frequency and quality factor of system ldquoresonator-samplerdquo is executed. articleTitle: Theory and practice of construction of radio channels of local wireless networks with adjusted quality of information transmission
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The approximate method of the reckoning of radio channels of local wireless networks with quality index not worse than the one adjusted to all of the three areas of emission (Reley, Fresnel, Fraunhofer) has been developed. Radio channel of subscriber radio access system with productivity not worse than the one adjusted has been projected. Experimental researches of the methods of quality improvement of information transmission in multipath radio channels have been done.

articleTitle: Parallel algorithms performance tools in network environment
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Operation stages at parallel computing complexes organization are considered in the present article. The attention is mainly paid concerning the one of main computing process organization stages - parallel algorithms development and their realization using legacy parallel programming technologies.

articleTitle: Specificity of signals reception in digital radio channels of the millimetric wave band
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The primary goals at creation of communication channels is to provide the specified data rate. In order to maximize the accuracy of data transmission, one can use the methods for optimal reception of discrete signals. In long-wave bands the noise source is thermal floataions in the receiving apparatus, as well as signals distortion. Thus the propagation medium (atmosphere) is supposed to be ideal, i.e. it is noiseless, lossless and undistorting. In order to provide optimal reception of discrete signals it is sufficient to know their a priori thin signal structure. However in millimeter band the Earth atmosphere possesses dispersion properties, which are sufficiently changing because of the weather. Due to this fact it is necessary to know the changes of thin structure under the influence of atmosphere.

articleTitle: Frequency-modulated oscillations-based measurement of a resonator quality factor
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Method for measurement of quality factor of a resonator is proposed. Features of this method are application of oscillator of frequency-modulated electromagnetic oscillations connected to a resonator, measurement of maximal and minimal amplitudes of received oscillations and determination of quality factor through ratio of these amplitudes.

articleTitle: Increasing the number of users in multi-carrier CDMA system
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: It is given the possibility of the more effective use of a frequency resource of the Ukraine by applying the technology CDMA with multi carrier. Is examined the influence of the growth of the carrier fluctuations on the capacity, the speed of transmission and quantity of subscribers of network. Is given the method of splitting cell with the addition carrier in several adjacent sectors. Described in this paper is the possibility of more efficient service of the frequency resource using multi-carrier CMA system. The influence of carrier fluctuations expansion on traffic capacity, transmission rate and the number of users within the network has been examined. The method of cell splitting is described, supposing carriers addition in different adjacent segments.

articleTitle: Retransmitter meter signal delay dependence on the diameter of the reflector in Fresnel zone
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: It has been calculated using numerical technique the phase incursion variations dependencies on plane reflector diameter for the retransmitting range meter operating in Fresnel zone. It has been determined that for the near reactive zone approach the reflector diameter variation causes fast increase of signal delay, within some places the sign of increasing changes. In the region of the Fresnel and Fraunhoffer zones boundary the dependencies become steady and speed of changing decreases with reflector moving away from the meter.

Also, the approach provides the efficient optimization of MMICpsilas.

abstract: A multi functional model of microstrip devices with a travelling-wave ring resonator has been proposed. There were drawn a comparison of the characteristics of the devices coming out of the proposed and classic models. Their adequacy has been confirmed that allows to consider this model a multifunctional one.

articleTitle: Impact of the ionospheric and atmospheric irregularities on the navigational satellites signals propagation
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The model of small scale fluctuations of the troposphere and lower stratosphere, incorporating previously published observational data, is proposed. Numerical simulations of the signal propagation of the global navigational satellite system (GPS) through the fluctuations of lower atmosphere are performed. Corresponding errors in the refractivity height profile, reconstructed by the radio occultation technique, are estimated. Oblique reflections of the waves from the ionospheric sporadic layers are simulated. Impact of the small scale fluctuations of the ionospheric plasma is discussed.

articleTitle: Qualitative analysis of forming of electron flow on edge of anode voltage pulse in cold-cathode magnetron
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A possible scenario of forming (secondary-emission multiplication and charge storage) of an electron flow on the edge of anode voltage pulse in the cold-cathode magnetrons is considered. A role of electromagnetic fields of low-voltage spurious modes is shown and influence of these modes to secondary-emission multiplication on edge of anode voltage pulse is made more exact. In this paper a qualitative analysis of multiplication and charge storage processes on edge of the anode voltage pulse in the cold-cathode magnetrons is considered. An influence of excited low-voltage spurious modes into the mechanism of increasing of space charge up to a moment of establishing of main mode (π - mode) is investigated.

articleTitle: Numerical and experimental study of controlling characteristics of generation in low-voltage vircator by external harmonical signal
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In the work we display the experimental and computational investigation of dynamics of an electron beam with virtual cathode in diode space with breaking voltage. Controlling of system dynamics with the help of microwave velocity modulation of the electron beam is discussed. Different complex regimes depending on the value of breaking voltage and the parameters of controlling signal, and defining the system behavior are observed and analyzed.

articleTitle: Field emissin system for cold-cathode magnetron “firing”
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: We have examined the field emission primary electron sources for initiating the pulsed terahertz cold-secondary electron emission cathode SWMpsilas. The causes for an initiation delay and other factors associated with setting the steady oscillation mode at field emission side cathode currents are elucidated.

articleTitle: Properties and technology of sputtering of yttrium iron garnet films for spin-wave electronics
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology

articleTitle: TWR application for quadripoles investigation at microwaves

articleTitle: The influence of dielectric resonator conductive surface impedance on the resonator spectral and energy characteristics
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The impedance influence on complex frequencies of hemispherical dielectric resonators has been studied. The expressions for determination of conductor inclusion factor were obtained. articleTitle: Studying of possibility of determination of parameters of hydrometeors using radiosignals of geostationary satellites
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology

articleTitle: X-band MMIC broadband low-noise amplifiers based on 0.15 μm GaAs pHEMT technology
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The design and fabrication of 2- and 3-stage X-band MMIC broadband low-noise amplifiers (LNA’s) based on 0.15 μm GaAs pHEMT technology is presented. MMIC’s are implemented with 0.15 μm pHEMT GaAs technology. The measured scattering parameters and noise figure are presented. articleTitle: Evaluation of rising-sun magnetron competition ability
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Discussed in this paper is competition ability of mm-wave anode and vane-type rising-sun magnetrons operating on pi - modes. Competition ability of mm-wave different-cavity anode magnetron has been determined. This type of magnetron is operating on non - pi - modes.

articleTitle: On the influence of anode voltage pulse in cold-cathode magnetron triggering
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In mm-wave space-harmonic magnetrons use is made both of the main cold secondary-electron emitter cathode to produce the operating current and of an ancillary cathode with a thermo-electron emitter, which is located at the end of the main cathode to ensure the triggering current. The paper presents the results of 3-D simulation of the magnetron triggering process. It is shown that there exists a relationship between the magnitude of the ancillary cathode current and the steepness of anode voltage pulse, at which the self-oscillations in a magnetron cannot be induced.

articleTitle: Investigation of microwave energy propagation character along single-conductor line

articleTitle: The effect of the retransmitter channel phase characteristics on the signal delay in range meters

articleTitle: Modeling of the nonlinear dynamics in a Gunn chaos oscillator

abstract: The nonlinear dynamics of a conventional GaAs Gunn diode operating in a waveguide resonant circuit has been examined. articleTitle: Some features of global seismicity in periods after the strongest solar flares

publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology

articleTitle: Nonlinear processes in the chain of gyro-backward wave tube
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present report deals with investigation of nonlinear dynamics of unidirectional connected gyro-backward wave tube (GBWT). It was shown that itpsilas possible to establish both modes of chaotic generation and the mode of stationary oscillations in the GBWT at changing of control parameters.

articleTitle: Effects of terahertz radiation generation by homogeneous laser-excited semiconductors
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Theoretical explanation of magnetic field impact on terahertz radiation generation by femtosecond-laser-excited narrow band-gap semiconductors is proposed. Surface depletion electric field screening influence on terahertz emission by means of nonlinear optical rectification is analyzed. Free-carrier electro-optical effect in semiconductors in the presence of the constant electric field is investigated.

articleTitle: Methods of waveguide-dielectric radiators for phased antenna arrays development and research
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The research results of phased antenna arrays waveguide-dielectric radiators are shown. Electrodynamic methods of computation and application packages realizing are analyzed. Calculation and experimental results giving realistic view of radiator directional pattern shape and width and its gain changing due to mutual coupling of array antenna elements for wide beam scanning sector phased antenna arrays radiators are compared.

articleTitle: The system for people rescue in the case of obstruction
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Discussed in this paper are the aspects regarding the system for people rescue in the case of obstruction. Search technique and operation principle of the searching apparatus are presented.

articleTitle: Satcom data processor
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A satcom data processor has been developed. The data processor is intended for use within a satellite communication system.

articleTitle: Controlled structures on the basis of disk dielectric resonators in a millimeter wave range
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Results of experimental studying of spectral, power and field characteristics single and connected WGM DDR with the help of the computerized measuring stand are resulted. The possibility of creation of controlled EHF elements on the basis of connected DDR for probable application in terahertz and optical ranges of frequencies is shown by the example of five connected resonators.

articleTitle: Direct measurement method for refraction index of liquids in Q-band
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The possibility of complex refraction index measurement for liquids with small viscosity using the oscillating string is demonstrated. The proposed method provides rapid determination of liquidpsilas dielectric parameters without complicated mathematical analysis of results. Precision of the proposed method is of the same order, as that of waveguide method of refractive index measurement. The facilities of method are demonstrated using the results of several liquids measurements.

articleTitle: The influence of barrier height on the current sensitivity of a microwave Schottky detector
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The properties of silicon Schottky diodes are studied using a one-dimensional physical-topological model. Diode current-voltage characteristics and detector current versus dissipated power are computed. The influence of the diode barrier height on the low-power current sensitivity is investigated.

articleTitle: Compositional medium consisted of anisotropic ferrite particles inserted in nonmagnetic matrix
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The magnetic susceptibility tensor of compositional medium consisted of anisotropic ferrite particles in non-magnetic matrix is calculated. The obtained results are analyzed to increase ferrite devices frequency range.

articleTitle: Amplifiers, frequency multipliers, oscillators on gyrotons
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The design and the efficiency of a gyroton-samplifiers, a gyroton-frequency multipliers and a gyroton-oscillators on corrugated resonator are presented.

articleTitle: Nanostructures of Si/SiO2/metal systems with swift heavy ion tracks
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Structures on the base of n-Si/SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> with nanopores in silicon dioxide layers filled with Cu and Ni particles are prepared by means of the swift heavy ion track technology, and investigated. A selectivity of nanopores filling with metals is shown. Current-voltage characteristics of the studied structures are carried out and a feasibility of the TEMPOS technology application for a creation of magnetically sensitive structures is presented.

articleTitle: Troposphere diagnostics on satellite radiosetting
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Work contains the analysis of possibilities of determination of troposphere refraction index gradient on the height and distant attenuation factor gradients of UHF radio signal in shadow or half-shadow area of the radio-occultation satellite path. The simplified relations are used for calculation. It is determined, that diagnostics on the height attenuation factor gradient is more effective.

articleTitle: DC-2 GHz 4-bit digital MMIC attenuator with a small insertion phase
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Results of development of the DC-2 GHz 4-bit digital MMIC attenuator with a small insertion phase plusmn3deg have been presented. The attenuator chip with dimensions of 1.7times1.8 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> has been made to provide insertion loss about 1.3 dB and the signal amplitude control on range from 0 to 15 dB with 1-dB step.

articleTitle: Excitation and propagation of spin waves in ferromagnetic films at the first order parametric resonance
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In the paper the excitation and propagation features of spin waves at the first order parametric resonance are discussed on the basis of experimental and theoretical results. These results are obtained in the case, when the electromagnetic or magnetostatic wave is a pump wave.

articleTitle: Objects detection at feature level using form coefficient
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Investigation of water object detection methodology within multilevel information fusion method based on feature level using form coefficient is carried out.

articleTitle: The principles and implementation of the broadcasting digital TV systems over IPTV
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The implementation of the converter of DVB-ASI stream to IPTV stream and backwards is considered. On the basis of it the former IPTV-100 is produced by ldquoBeta TV comrdquo enterprise.

articleTitle: OFDM signal behaviour for microcell and cell radio systems of millimeter-wave band mobile communication
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: OFDM signals characteristics for microcellular and cellular broadband radio-systems of millimeter-wave band mobile communication are offered. The analysis of the offered signals is submitted from the point of view of an opportunity of formation frequency - not selective channel.

articleTitle: Electrical model of semiintegrator
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper proposes the electrical semiintegrator microstrip design with distributed resistive-capacitive constants.

articleTitle: Neural-genetic method applied to the design of Vivaldi antenna
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A neural-genetic concept is proposed for the synthesis of Vivaldi antenna. A device to be optimized is modeled by artificial neural networks and synthesis is made by genetic algorithm based inversion of the artificial neural networks.

articleTitle: Hydrolytic enzyme preparations as the objects of EHF radiation influence
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The researches in vitro of EHF electromagnetic radiation influence on enzyme activity are carried out. The stimulating frequency of hydrolyses subclass (proteases and alpha amylases) enzymes activity is found. The enzyme activity frequency dependence carries out high resonance character (looks like high resonance curve). It is shown that enzyme activity depends on Ca<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+2</sup>-iones concentration in reaction environment. The radiation raises Ca<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+2</sup>-iones stimulating effect too. The probable mechanism of mm-waves influence on enzyme preparations range is discussed.

articleTitle: The method of theoretical calibration of transient process by electromagnetic field in resonator sorption moisture meter
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Proposed in this paper is the technique for strict definition of resonant frequency in resonator humidity sensor based on the measuring of sorbent insert permittivity during the change of specific humidity of the flow under test. For that optimization of the working chamber design has been carried out, in order to define boundary condition, which suppose the strict mathematical representation of diffusion processes, as well as electromagnetic field interaction with the sorbent.

articleTitle: Semiconductor surface quality influence on MESFET’s parameters
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Surface energy states form parasitic p-n junction which influences greatly not only MESFETpsilas breakdown voltage but also its microwave parameters.

articleTitle: Synthesis and physical properties of some compounds of AIIBIVCV2 group
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: CdGeAs<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>{Mn}, CdGeP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>{Mn}, ZnGeAs<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>{Mn}, and CdGeAs<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>{Co} solid solutions are investigated in the present work. articleTitle: Frequency doublers with cross-section modulation of the electron beam
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Potentially effective schemes of frequency doublers with cross-section modulation of electron beam are considered.

articleTitle: Elimination of parasitic generation in power X-band internally matched transistors with high associated gain
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Stability problems for X-band internally matched HEMTpsilas with output power higher than 10 W, associated gain higher than 13 dB are discussed. Several variants of schematic design for parasitic generation elimination are proposed.

articleTitle: Using correlation signal processing for the extraction of the signals from a noise level in ferromagnetic films
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The correlation of magnetostatic wave pulses in yttrium-iron garnet (YIG) films was investigated theoretically and experimentally. This method allows observing the signals below the noise level in a wide frequency band. An additional pumping pulse is proposed to use for the creation of time inverted reference signal, for the correlation of delayed direct and reversal by pumping signal pulses.

articleTitle: Providing basic data for the wood segment of GEOUA - information service system “leskosmos” (Forest-UA)
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: On the stage of elaboration of Forest-UA system, as a wood segment of GEOUA national program, the following remote sensing principles should be realized: synchronous remote and necessary field measurements of the surface and meteorological parameters; repeated observations in order to estimate changeability of the surface reflective properties and increase detection reliability; using a priori information about the surface reflective properties from contrasting schemes.

articleTitle: 24-channel frequency dividing unit of S-band
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology

articleTitle: Differential determination of differences for phases in microwave phase systems using phenomena of front curvature of electromagnetic waves
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology

articleTitle: System modelling of satellite communication system transceivers in mm range
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Considered in this paper is mathematical and program modeling of terrestrial stations’ (TS) transceivers, which are the part of satellite communication system (SCS). Simulation results are presented at the influence of test harmonic signal and at the influence of the real modulated signals; the quality indexes received are the basis for a task decision on the circuit level.

articleTitle: Television image proccessing by means of spatial filtration and filtration in frequency domain using MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology

articleTitle: Substrate batch effect on GaAs MESFET characteristics under ultra-short pulses exposure
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Experimental investigation of GaAs MESFET substrate batch effect on characteristics of ultra-short pulses exposure was carried out. This effect was developed and described.

articleTitle: Simulation of dynamic temperature distribution of high power microwave devices and new flip-chip design
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology

articleTitle: Modelling of SAR transceiver as a complex system
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology

publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The differential dielectrometer (DD) was designed that allows showing surely enough small differences in complex permittivity between two high loss liquids, for instance, dry wines to show up fraud.

publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology

articleTitle: Calculation of magnetoresistance of thin GaAs quantum wires

abstract: The dependencies of magnetoresistance of thin GaAs quantum wires in pores of anodic Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> on the induction magnitude of constant and uniform in GaAs transverse magnetic field applied to the wires have been calculated at the liquid helium temperature.

articleTitle: Detector of microwave radiation on the basis of Bi1−xSbx film
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology

articleTitle: Electrically-tunable microwave phase shifter based on ferrite-piezoelectric layered structure
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A new class of electrically tunable microwave signal processing devices based on layered ferrite-piezoelectric structure is proposed. A trilayer magnetoelectric structure consisting of a lead magnesium niobate-lead titanate (PMN-PT) and yttrium iron garnet (YIG) film on gadolinium gallium garnet (GGG) substrate is considered. Design and experimental data of microstrip phase shifter are presented.

articleTitle: Analysis of relative permits depending on signal-noise ratio at the use of optimal on minimum error average square in signal processing algorithms
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
