articleTitle: Optimisation of nonuniform field biased magnetostatic surface waves transmission line parameters
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The constant phase lines for magnetostatic surface waves propagating along non-uniform biased ferrite film are calculated. The practical recommendations for transmission line parameters are given.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of scattering diagram calculation for monochromatic and pulsed input signals
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Comparison of bistatic RCS calculation results has been executed for finite-difference time-domain method and integral equation method. Research of influence of input pulsed signal kind and duration on scattered electromagnetic field is fulfilled for finite-difference time-domain method. The way for comparison of scattering diagram calculation results for one frequency and pulsed input signals has been proposed. Factors that influence upon these results are analyzed.

articleTitle: Technical and economic optimization of transceiver system of earth station of sattelite VSAT network
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The optimum technical parameters of the transceiver system providing the minimal cost of earth station at achievement of demanded quality are received.

articleTitle: Mathematical model of mobile communication network traffic
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The given work is devoted to the analysis of the real multimedia traffic of the mobile communication traffic with the aim to estimate its fractal properties and characteristics; the work is also devoted to practical particularities of construction of the mathematical model on the basis of wavelet-analysis methods for solution of practically important problems of prospective planning and prediction of the service quality in the network.

articleTitle: Microwave balanced mixer under the influence of power electromagnetic interference
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Experimental results of microwave balanced mixers investigation under power RF interference are presented.

articleTitle: The analysis of means of content delivery to transmitters of monofrequent DVB-T network of Ukraine
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The paper is dedicated to analysis of the means and ways to transmit informational content to SFN transmitter of the DVB-T network.

articleTitle: The influence of pulse electromagnetic fields on microcircuits ADC and DAC
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Described in this paper is the technique for conducting waveguide researches on the direct influence of pulse electromagnetic fields on ADC and DAC. Result of the experimental research are presented.

articleTitle: Design of L-, S- and C-band low noise amplifires
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Results of design of a series of the low noise amplifiers working over the bandwidth 1.0 to 9.0 GHz are presented. The design and the basic microwave parameters of schemes are described.

articleTitle: Modeling of microwave telecommunication devices and antennas by vector finite element method
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The computer code RFS3 based on vector finite element method and designated for electromagnetic simulation of real-life models of microwave telecommunication devices is described. Simulation results of the real mobile handset are in satisfactory agreement with the measurement data.

articleTitle: Application of near-field microwave probing to breast tumor detection
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: We have developed the theory for near-field microwave probing of spherical object placed inside the uniform half-space. The model has been applied to the problem of breast cancer detection. The analysis is based on the calculations of measured parameters in dependence of the tumor size and depth. The model experiment on detection of the contrast object immersed to water has been done. Our calculations and measurements gave the maximal depth of tumor detection ~ 1-2 cm.

articleTitle: Dielectric resonators for determination of materials electrophysical parameters
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The method for determination of material permittivity and permeability and conductor impedance using cylindrical and spherical resonators is presented.

articleTitle: Determination of electromagnetic properties of metamaterials with open-ended coaxial lines
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: As alternative to the commonly adopted S-parameter retrieval procedure, open-ended coaxial line method for determination of effective permittivity and permeability of metamaterials is proposed. Results of numerical simulation of reflection coefficient as a function of frequency are presented; limitations and advantage of the method are discussed. Losses effect on sensitivity of the method is considered.

articleTitle: Calculation of electrophysical parameters of armchair single-wall carbon nanotubes
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A number of electrophysical parameters of armchair single-wall carbon nanotubes are calculated. The parameters have been obtained by means of the direct numerical solution of system of the Boltzmann kinetic equations for both the electron and phonon gases.

articleTitle: About one of the possible mechanisms of realisation of superradiance operations in the relativistic BWO and TWT
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: One of possible mechanisms of super-radiance in the relativistic the BWO and TWT based on interaction of an impulse of an electronic pulse pro-modulated on an accelerating voltage with the sectionalized and irregular slow-wave system surveyed. Calculation and optimization on efficiency of parameters of section of the irregular slow-wave system in which there is an accumulation of energy at interaction of an electronic beam to a short electromagnetic impulse is carried out are completed.

articleTitle: Peculiarities of double photon intersubband transition in coherent transport triple-barrier structures
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The closed form solution of Schrodinger equation is found, it describes resonant transitions which happen in the large-signal high-frequency electric fields for asymmetric triple-barrier resonant-tunneling structures with thin and high (delta) barriers. It is also shown that the most of electrons falling on the upper energy level can emit two photons and then leave the structure without intermediate electron-phonon interaction with 160% quantum efficiency limit.

articleTitle: Diagnostics of the troposphere refraction by the signals of TV centers and satellite radiation
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Comparison of signals from TV centers on over the horizon route in a penumbra region and radiation from satellites of a global navigation system is carried out. Classification signatures are proposed which allow forecasting troposphere refraction state on propagation route at a signal change receiving from TV center or a satellite.

articleTitle: Tuning of electric parameters of waveguide coaxial resonator
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The control capabilities of the main characteristics of the TEM oscillations in the waveguide dielectric resonator (WCR) have been investigated. The dependences of the eigen resonance wavelength lambda and Q-factor of the TEM oscillations in the WCR as a function of the coaxial diameters, their longitudinal sizes and the short-circuit plunger position have been obtained.

articleTitle: Algorithms of signals processing in radio acoustic systems
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The algorithms of radio acoustic system signal processing constructed with allowance for a radiowave transformation in the channel and making it possible to perform qualitative measurements of atmosphere parameters not only with the fulfilled Bragg condition but with q ne 0 (q is a parameter of the Bragg condition disruption) and complex sonic pulsed radiation, are synthesised in this work.

articleTitle: Digital RRL of UHF-range
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Technical solutions enabling using air-free TV channels are considered for Internet or telephony within 60 km by means of not expensive RRL equipment.

articleTitle: Candy site finder, a planning tool for wireless networks
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The given work examines peculiarities of development and implementation of computer-aided design tools for high-performance combined fixed, wireless and mobile communication networks, corporate networks (CN). In the scope of authors interests a Planning Tool for Wireless Networks (IEEE 802.11a, b, g and 802.16) is situated. Site Finder, a Wireless Planning Tool is integrated within the CANDY Framework [1-3] and aimed to optimization of constellation of Access Points and Base Stations on PHY-layer under use of built-in project data visualization and documenting features. The obtained wireless networks solutions can be easily coupled with wired part of the designed CN as well as provide the further phases of integrated design workflow (cable system route tracing, load evaluation, performance and costs analysis).

articleTitle: Device on the basis of intervalley electron transfer effect
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The construction of device on intervalley electron transfer (IET) effect with increased efficiency is considered in the present report, which is intended for oscillator, amplifier and auto- dyne creation of cm- and mm-range for generation, amplification and conversion of UHF signals. Advantages of the offered construction of the device on intervalley electron transfer are: - much higher reliability level than for any other active solid- state elements (including all types of UHF field-effect-transistors with Shottky barrier (FET SB) and avalanche diodes); - higher level of impedance values than for FET SB and, hence, better possibilities for device matching with UHF path; - much lower phase noise level than for any other solid- state elements (all types of FET SB and IMPATT diodes); - much smaller sizes than for transistor IC on FET SB; - lack of strict requirements to technological equipment used for manufacture the chips of IET devices.

articleTitle: The fractal structured log-periodical vibrator antennas
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The theoretical bases are developed for a method validation of electrodynamic similarity of fractally structured log-periodical dipole antennas. The principle of similarity is formulated by language of the fractional order differential forms applied to the description of the artificial heterogeneous fractally structured medium. At the numerical decision of a methodical problem it revealed strong dependence of log-periodical vibrator characteristics versus scaling size.

articleTitle: Automated device analyzing human central nervous system in electromagnetic fields
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Described in this paper are the two types of reflexometers which analyze human visual and motor reaction. They are used for evaluation of functional state of human central nervous system.

articleTitle: Design of the ultrawideband 2,0–25,95 GHz test antenna
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of designing the measuring antenna for 2.0 to 25.95 GHz frequency are presented. The antenna is intended to generate the reference electromagnetic field during measurements with appropriate signal source and for electromagnetic field analysis, for electromagnetic environment monitoring, measurements of antenna parameters and small levels of electromagnetic power together with appropriate receivers. Wide frequency band, high technical performance and operational possibility within harsh climatic environment of minus 50degC-plus 60degC nominate this antenna as the best one inside the corresponding class of antennas. The antenna type is named as the Pi6-65.

articleTitle: Optimum filtration of GDV-images
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The method of optimum filtration of images obtained by the method of gas-unloading visualization is offered (GRV).

articleTitle: Non-relativistic dynamics of charged particles moving in a cylindrical drift tube
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A scheme of numerical calculations of intrinsic self-consistent electric field of a non-relativistic electron beam moving in a perfectly conducting cylindrical drift tube is proposed. It takes into account the charges, which are induced by the beam itself on the drift tube wall. Using Kirchhoff’s formula, we obtain expressions for calculations of dynamics of electrons, which can be also used for simulations of motion in a cylindrical drift tube whenever external electric and magnetic fields are present. The proposed approach is based on a preliminary calculation (and, if necessary, a subsequent interpolation) of the charge density distributions induced by a test point-like charge on the drift tube wall.

articleTitle: Luminescent structures based on porous anodic alumina
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In this study, the possibility of fabrication of europium- and terbium-doped structures based on porous anodic alumina (PAA) grown in orthophosphoric and oxalic acid electrolytes, has been investigated. Europium or terbium ions were introduced in the pores of anodic alumina by either impregnation with sols or by immersion in alcoholic solution containing lanthanide salts. Strong europium and terbium photoluminescence was observed not only from the structures xerogel/PAA, but in PAA films fabricated in orthophosphoric acid and immersed in solution of lanthanide Elemental depth profiles of PAA of 30 mum thickness revealed homogeneous distribution of lanthanides along the whole thickness of porous layer.

articleTitle: Relaxation processes in submicron structures with quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Results of impulse and energy relaxation times simulating and possibility of simulating of different submicron structures with quantum dots are presented.

articleTitle: Broadband power splitter-combiner application in phased-array antennas

abstract: Equations are obtained to solve the inverse problem of scattering by 2D field distribution outside the studied region of 3D inhomogeneities in a multilayered medium beyond the Born approximation of perturbation theory.

articleTitle: Coupling coefficients of stripline resonators in the filters based on suspended substrate
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Coupling coefficientspsila equations of resonators of two miniaturized stripline filters constructions on suspended substrate are derived. It was shown that inductive interaction of resonators on frequencies of the first pass-band exceeds capacitive one.

articleTitle: Increasing of working frequencies engagement ratio in superwideband systems

articleTitle: Research of four-detector slotted-guide microwave converter of calibrating reflection measuring set
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Processing of calibrating and measuring information incoming from power transducers of four-detector slotted-guide microwave converter algorithm is given.

articleTitle: The research of avalanche diode noise generation in anomaly mode
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The research of the noise oscillators 3 - mm wave band with double-drift avalanche diode (DDAD) which work in anomaly mode creation ways have been held. articleTitle: Microwave-diodes operating in pulse mode
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: It was experimentally studied the change of longitudinal sizes of microwave diode active structure in the pulse mode. Relative increment of longitudinal sizes of semiconductor structure in anode-to-cathode direction was 3...5% at the nominal supply voltage. At the low pulse repetition rate there was a tangible vibration of semiconductor structure.

articleTitle: Space coherence of the aperture antenna radiation field in the environment with casual heterogeneities
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Formulas for the estimation of the radiation field spatial coherence of the antenna with inphase uniform distribution in its aperture are derived. Results of numerical calculations are presented.

articleTitle: W-band high power ferrite phase shifters research
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Questions of the design of W-band high power waveguide ferrite phase shifters for waveguide transmission lines are considered. Alternative phase shifter arrangements based upon a Faraday phase shifter and a Reggia-Spencer phase shifter are analyzed. It is shown, that a device changing phase shift within the limits from 0 to 2pi, when a pulse power is up to 2 kW and a refrigeration power is up to 10 W, can be created.

articleTitle: The mm-wave application for optimization of plants’ evolution
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A plant physiology development model is proposed taking into account interference of biological fields of different morphological structures for all growth periods. A principal possibility to optimize different development periods for phyto-systems by means of electromagnetic radiation of different frequency bands is shown.

articleTitle: Technological optimization of materials’ drying process in the microwave chambers
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The design principles of designing and technological optimization of the microwave installations for drying materials are developed. The peak profit on embodying the given technological process can be gained only at optimum values of its variables and parameters which enter into criterion function - technological parameters, properties of a material of drying, requirements and order of operation, cost performances.

articleTitle: Mode excitation in DRO with phase shift of the field in the middle of interaction space
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The experimental results on mode excitation in the diffraction radiation oscillator (DRO) with phase inversion of a field of the open resonant system (ORS) in the middle of interaction space are presented. The DRO for 5-mm wavelength worked on a TEM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">01q</sub>-mode with output power 3divide5 Watt in a wide band of frequency tuning. 4-5 timespsila increase of starting current for a competitive surface mode of oscillations in comparison with homogeneous grating was observed.

articleTitle: Collection and storage of hydrogen micro- and nanopowders of silicon
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The process of hydrogen transportation into a silicon powder has been investigated. It is also established, that in the process of transition from nano- to microsizes is an accumulation of hydrogen takes place, both in volume, and on the surface of the powder.

articleTitle: Novel compact substrate integrated waveguide resonators at 60 GHz for LCP
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In this paper a new approach to design of compact substrate integrated resonators is presented. LCP substrate integrated waveguide is loaded by array of multilayer metallic plates situated inside the substrate. Resonators are designed and simulated with a resonant frequency of 60 GHz. Proposed structures are twice more compact than their conventional substrate integrated counterparts.

articleTitle: Pervasive Computing usage for realization conception Smart auditory
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Conception of Smart auditory is offered in this article. Approach based on Pervasive Computing and software based on technology UPnP is used for this realization. Practical realization of this conception is considered on the example of information about the curriculum of lessons in a current auditory. This conception allows adding new property to the auditory, namely intellectuality.

articleTitle: Computer microwave diagnostic system for measurement of parameters of sandwich-like micro- and nano-structures
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The Computer Diagnostic System for measurement of parameters of sandwich-like metal-dielectric and metal-semiconductor micro- and nano-structures from the reflection and transmission microwave spectra, developed in Saratov State University, is presented.

articleTitle: Signals space-time processing methods with four-dimensional matrices using
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Space-time processing (STP) methods for interference cancellation and signal extraction using four-dimensional matrices are shown.

articleTitle: Automated millimeter band spectrometer for scanning ESR-microscope with localized magnetic field
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Automated spectrometer of scanning millimeter band ESR microscope is developed. The main features are high frequency resolution, small scanning step and high dynamic range. The system of controlling and monitoring allows tuning the generator frequency, moving test object in the resonator and recording amplitude of microwave field when moving object is relative to magnetic gap. Measurements of electron spin resonance in check paramagnetic samples having known saturation intensity are done.

articleTitle: Temperature feature analysis of autodyne oscillators on gunn diode
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Theoretical analysis fulfilled for temperature impact upon autodyne oscillators shows that this factor causes the self-oscillation condition changing first of all: namely, auto-bias, amplitude and frequency of oscillations, as well as output power. Temperature curves of the autodyne potential, its output levels of the signal and noise are determined by behavior of an autodyne gain factor, which in turn depends of the temperature variations of oscillator limit cycle fastness. Experimental research of autodyne properties, which is made on the basis of hybrid-integrated circuit “Tigel-08”, shows that its potential and levels of output signal and noise in temperature range from −50 to +50° C vary not more than 3 dB. Temperature frequency factor of these modules is (5.3–8) ·10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup> 1/degree which corresponds with conventional microwave oscillators.

articleTitle: The full-wave analysis of microstrip phased array of combined printed radiators with adequate simulation of feeds
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Full-wave solution of electromagnetic problem about lumped excitation microstrip phased array with longitudinal printed radiators has been obtained. Novelty of the offered mathematical model consists in the adequate description of a stripline feeder influence on characteristics of the microstrip array. It is reached by full-wave modeling, as a microstrip radiator of the phased antenna array, as that part of a stripline feeder which directly adjoins to antenna element of an array.

articleTitle: Research of circular disc ultra wideband EMC measuring antenna
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) measuring antenna can be used for EMC radiation disturbed and noise immunity test. Its bandwidth requirement is relatively high, and the antenna needs to cover a wide frequency range. In this paper, the conventional circular disc ultra wideband antenna was expanding researched, and a new method to increase the high frequency of the circular disc antenna was introduced. A small disk monopole was added to the original antenna. Simulation and experiment results show that this method can greatly improve in maintaining the high-frequency antenna-bandwidth, in order to address the trouble of replacing several antennas for EMC measurement. In addition, the problem of wind load for EMC measuring antenna was also taken into account. The corresponding solutions were proposed by simulation results. Holes and slots were punched on the conventional circular disc antenna, or to simplify the circular disc antenna to loop antenna. Analysis shows that the wind load can be reduced. These methods can improve the mechanical characteristics of the antenna on the basis of maintaining the good performance. The improved antennas are more applicable to EMC measurement.

articleTitle: Compact radiator for microwave hyperthermia
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The problem of electromagnetic waves radiation by the system of crossed curvature vibrators, located over perfectly conducting plane, into flat-layered medium with losses, modeling biological tissue of a man, has been solved using finite element method. The plots for the distribution of the electrical field amplitudes in different layers depending on the difference of vibrators excitation phases are represented.

articleTitle: F. I. Kolomoytsev - the founder of investigations in field of microwave physics and engineering in pridneper region (on the occasion of Kolomoytsev’s 100th anniversary)
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The life and activities of outstanding scientist Fedor Isaakovich Kolomoytsev is presented. His 100 anniversary has been celebrated this year. Kolomoytsevpsilas contribution in the development of materials for microwave engineering, microwave measurements, antenna technique and microwave devices production is brilliant. He was a founder and the first head of the department of microwave physics in Dnepropetrovsk State University.

articleTitle: Microwave permittivity measurement of multi-component solutions at two frequencies
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The usefulness of permittivity measurement at two frequencies for the analysis of multi-component water solution dielectric properties in microwave range is shown. The ratio of these two frequencies should be equal to 4. The advantages of the proposed method are demonstrated by measurement of dry table wine permittivity.

articleTitle: Wideband matched loads based on waveguide photonic structures with nanometer metal layers
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The possibility of creation of wideband matched loads based on waveguide photonic structures consisted of alternating layers of dielectrics and nanometer-thin metals with different values of electrophysical parameters has been shown theoretically and proven experimentally.

articleTitle: The theory of clinotron with non-fixed longitudinal structure of RF field
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The theory of clinotron with non-fixed longitudinal structure of microwave field is presented. It is shown that in this case normalized electron efficiency of the clinotron is slightly lower than the maximal efficiency of traditional BWO.

articleTitle: Resonant tunneling diode based on nitride gallium nanostructural cathode

articleTitle: Microwave telecommunication system with increased spectral efficiency
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Described in this paper is MITRIS-based telecommunication system MITRIS-MUI using combined modulation with increased spectral efficiency and possibility of serving the wider area. Engineering solution of MITRIS-MUI meets the requirements of resource-economy and ecological safety.

articleTitle: Measuring information signals in microwave micro- and nanodiagnostics of semiconductor materials and structures
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology

articleTitle: “Visual” design of matching networks for MMICs

articleTitle: Abrasive and extrusion processing in manufacture of details for the microwave devices

articleTitle: X-band high pulse power amplifier
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of X-band high pulse power amplifier design are presented. The amplifier supplies a 70-80 W peak pulse power and operates with instantaneous bandwidths of 8.4-8.7 GHz.

articleTitle: KU-band dielectric resonator diplexer
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The principles and results of the design of Ku-band microwave diplexers on dielectric resonators (DR) are discussed. Diplexers have insertion losses less than 2.0 dB at 1.4% passband and 60 dB isolation between channels.

articleTitle: The features of the partial reflection signals, radionoises and electron density variations in the middle latitude D-region of the ionosphere during the magnetic storms in 2004–2006

abstract: The changes of the partial reflection signals, radio-noises at 2.2-2.4 MHz and the electron density variations in the middle latitude D-region before, during and after five magnetic storms in 2004-2006 are investigated by the partial reflection technique. articleTitle: Stability and periodical motion of charged particles in crossed-field systems
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The stability and periodic motion in nonlinear dynamical systems such as ldquomagnetron dioderdquo and magnetron are considered. articleTitle: Cold cathode emission in a magnetron diode
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In the present paper the 3-D model is employed to analyze the electron hub generation process in a magnetron diode with a secondary-emission cathode whose operation is stimulated by priming electrons from ancillary side cathode. It is shown that the electron emitted from the cold cathode areas at the diode ends has an effect upon the rate of space charge density, it is needed to trigger the secondary electron multiplication process over the entire operating surface of the main cathode.

articleTitle: Limiting saturation levels of wake fields excited by lengthy electron bunches in the dielectric resonator
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology

articleTitle: Creation of NTUU ≪KPI≪ web portal on the basis of the modern information-telecommunication technologies

Also the example of such system creation on NTUU ldquoKPIrdquo base is given.

articleTitle: Determining resonator resonance frequency by AFC measurement results

abstract: The method of resonance frequency calculation by sampled AFC curve is presented. Calculation accuracy dependence on frequency sampling increment, ADC width and additive noise level are estimated by simulation with MATLAB environment.

articleTitle: Model of quasioptical directivity properties of antenna arrays in Fresnel zone
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Influence of phase front curvature of electromagnetic waves on the directivity of antenna array in Fresnel area is reviewed, and also the problems of their directive properties management in the given area are solved.

articleTitle: Microwave measuring transducer of deformation of piece works
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The work shows a fact that one can control a process of deformation of piece works by using vibrational properties of an open resonator and characteristics of frequency-modulated oscillation.

articleTitle: Signal shaper of DVB-T single frequency network

abstract: Technical decisions enabling realization of COFDM portable transmitter are considered. This device is developed and produced by Beta TV com LTD.

articleTitle: Measuring-modelling complexes for alignment and antennas measurements
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Special automated complexes which allow integrating the processes of modeling, designing, evaluation of the phased-array antenna (PAA) parameters for further aligning and conducting acceptance tests and field trials are considered in this report. It is shown that for comprehensive evaluation of multifunction PAA technical state and parameters it is necessary to combine simulation, complete diagnostic, initial alignment and further auto-tuning of multi channel PAA, with statistical approach to antenna measurements, taking into account constructive peculiarities and restrictions.

articleTitle: Frequency dispersion in GaAs metal-semiconductor field-effect transistor transconductance
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A quasi-2D numerical model a GaAs metal-semiconductor field-effect transistor, which drops the conventional sharp-boundary approximation, is presented. Using this model, both the low- and the high-frequency transistor transconductance is calculated. It is shown that the transconductance shows marked frequency dispersion in the drain current saturation region, which may have a significant impact on the small-signal voltage gain of a transistor amplifier.

articleTitle: Millimeter wave receiver for communication circuits
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of the receive development in 40.5 - 42.5 GHz for communication circuits are presented. The receiver realized accomplished an amplification of input signal and following conversion in standard frequency band 0.95 - 2.15 GHz. The main functional units are designed on base of microwave monolithic integrated circuits (MMIC). Noise factor of the receiver was not more than 4.2 dB.

articleTitle: Diagnostics of a propagation medium of GPS signals by single-frequency receivers
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The application of GPS single-frequency receivers for diagnostics of a propagation medium of the satellite navigational system (SNS) signals founded on determination of the sloping ionospheric correction by measurement of a phase paths difference of navigational signals from two satellites is represented.

articleTitle: Radiopulse protection device basedon the HTS film
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A microstrip radiopulse protection device novel design is investigated. The device operation is based on the permeability changing of HTS film, when it transforms to the normal state in presence of acting electromagnetic radiation.

articleTitle: Reconstraction of spatial spectrum of troposphere non-uniformities on amplitude fluctuations transversal correlation functions
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Work contains the analysis of possibilities of reconstruction spatial spectrums of troposphere non-uniformities on transversal correlation functions of satellite radio signal amplitude fluctuations. The theoretical analysis was carried out on the base of relations for electromagnetic plane wave in the weakly perturbed turbulent troposphere. The radio occultation inverse problem is reduced to Fredholm integral equation of the first type with a self-conjugate kernel. The numeral solution of this incorrect equation was executed by alpha-regularization method. Algorithm to be developed was made on model profiles. The reconstruction of real spatial spectrums was carried out on radio signal frequency spectrums.

articleTitle: Competition of modes in a rising-sun magnetron
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A special consideration is given to the condition under which the competition of modes may exist in a rising-sun π - mode magnetron as well as to the prerequisites to the stable generation operating on a mode. It is shown, when the space harmonic spectrum contains a π -mode component with a zero azimuthal number the probability of decreasing its competitiveness tends to grow. The reason why it happens is that if the HF homogeneity of a rising-sun system is disturbed, it may bring about significant radiation losses due to the transformation of an zero-component into a H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</inf> wave.

articleTitle: Theoretical and experimental investigation of noise influence on the klystron autogenerator dynamics
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present report deals with numerical and experimental investigation of noise influence on klystron autogenerator dynamics. The noise influence suppresses the signal on the klystron output.

articleTitle: Kimberlite fracture by prompt microwave-heating
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Report is devoted to research processes of kimberlite fracture by their superprompt microwave heating. The processes of kimberlite fracture are considered and the fracture mechanisms are determined. The kimberlite dielectric performances are studied. The results of fracture processes studied on installation of resonator type with microwave power 600 W are presented. The basic characteristics of kimberlite fracture processes are defined. Executed efficacy estimations of kimberlite fracture by microwave heating indicate prospects of this new method.

articleTitle: A mobile Ku-band earth station: Characteristics and capabilities
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology

Dependences of the frequency characteristics of the system on the sizes and the aperture position in the diaphragm and on the distance between the diaphragm and the piston are calculated. The theoretical and experimental results agreement is detected.

articleTitle: Propagation of microwave signals along a two- wire line with a laser filament for a conductor
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: We demonstrate the possibility to transport microwaves along a two-wire line, in which a plasma filament produced in air by intense femtosecond laser radiation acts as one of the conductors. It is shown that as a microwave signal propagates along such a line, pulses are formed in it, which have duration decreasing monotonously as the path length increases up to a length compared with the period of the microwave field. By changing the parameters of these pulses, one can determine the plasma density in the filament.

articleTitle: MEMS macromodels construction method
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology

abstract: Results of study and development of technological processes of deep anisotropic etching of micromechanical elements (MME) of microelectromechanical systems (MEMS) for VHF devices are submitted.

articleTitle: Random inhomogeneities in microresonator: Theory and modeling at millimeter wave band
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The influence of random inhomogeneities placed on the microresonator face on its spectral properties was studied theoretically and experimentally. The original spectral theory of open dielectric disk resonator with random surface inhomogeneities was elaborated. The mechanisms of the influence of inhomogeneities on eigen resonant frequency and on the spectral lines width were clarified. publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The capabilities of the step-by-step determination of the permittivity and loss-angle tangent as well as the conductivity of the waveguide material via the resonance characteristics of the waveguide-dielectric resonator (WDR) have been presented.

articleTitle: Procedure of choice of an extraneous source of radio emission, for the diversed radar system of meteoric trails
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The procedure which allows from an existing broadcasting network of radio and television stations to choose an optimum source of a radio emission with the high-ratio of signal/noise on a receiver. The received results can be useful in construction of systems of registration of quantity and detection of a radiant of meteoric reflections with small expenses.

articleTitle: Transmitting device of group signal of 10.5–10.65 GHz range with high linearity
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The technical solution of a converter-amplifier enables converting the signals of UHF range (710 - 860 MHz) in the range of 10.5 - 10.65 GHz with output power of 1 W at low intermodulation distortion (-40 dBc) is presented.

articleTitle: Some characteristics of 4G communication networks
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This article presents some characteristics of cellular communication of 4G networks. These characteristics should be taken into consideration during engineering.

articleTitle: Radiation effects in carbon nanotube devices
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The ionizing radiation effects on carbon nanotubes based diode and transistor structures are investigated.

articleTitle: Variation of parameters of detector diodes under the influence of short power microwave pulses
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Microwave detector diode response on short high-power RF pulses is investigated. It is shown that the variation of detected pulse shape under the increasing of RF power is due to saturation effect and heating of rectifying contact.

articleTitle: Application of microwave energy for food products’ incineration
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The construction of stove for food productspsila incinerating by microwave energy at frequency of 2450 MHz is offered. The construction of irradiation structure that distributes the electromagnetic field energy from a magnetron on four equal parts is offered too. The calculation of the electromagnetic fields in a stove at given location of vessels with the explored product is conducted.

articleTitle: Coronated antenna for UHF band with circular polarized radiation
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This study is based on numerical simulations and covers a flat radiating structure having linear polarization of radiation and a coronated antenna having circular polarization, the latter being tube-shaped with three slots and feeding circuit based on a microstrip line.

articleTitle: System for radiowave diagnostics of oncological skin diseases
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The system for radiowave diagnostics of oncological skin diseases is developed. The system is based on registration of electromagnetic emission from a human body in mm range. The algorithm of analysis and classification of functional condition of tissue in dependence on the parameters of its own electromagnetic radiation in mm range is developed. The system for radiowave diagnostics allows detecting oncological skin disease at the early stage.

articleTitle: Measurement complex permittivity of high loss using resonator with ring cavity
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: We proposed a new complex permittivity measurement technique for high loss liquids in small volume at millimeter wave band. This technique is based on the use of cavity resonator with radial belt with liquid. Such resonant cell was studied numerically and experimentally. The resonator spectrum was studied depending on permittivity of high loss liquids at deviation of main resonator parameters. A good agreement between numerical study and experimental data has obtained. The optimal resonator proportions corresponding spectral parameters and operating oscillation mode were determined to provide maximal sensitivity during complex liquid permittivity measurement.

articleTitle: The influence of precursors grain dimension on cation ordering in Sr2FeMoO6−δ
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The influence of grain sizes of SrFeO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> and SrMoO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> precursors on phase transitions sequence, and Fe<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>and Mo<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5+</sup> cations ordering in Sr<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>FeMoO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6−δ</inf> is investigated.

articleTitle: Calculation of reflection factor H01-waves of a round wave guide from a dielectric window with a compensating groove
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The method of calculation of irregular wave guides with partial dielectric filling is offered. articleTitle: Microwave oscillations in log-periodic antenna integrated with a field-effect transistor
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Microwave oscillations in the hybrid integrated circuit consisted of field-effect transistor and microstrip log-periodical antenna is experimentally studied. The oscillations were observed both at the basic resonant frequency of the antenna and at the harmonics from 6 GHz to 60 GHz. The opportunities for set-up optimization were studied in application to millimeter wave frequency region.

articleTitle: Chaotic MW signal responces in a self-oscillatory system with the nonlinear magnetostatic wave transmission line
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In this paper the spectral, time and statistical responses of the chaotic MW signals are studied on the basis of the experimental data. These signals are generated by the self-oscillatory system with the nonlinear magnetostatic surface wave (MSSW) transmission line. The bifurcation diagram for this system is also calculated.

articleTitle: System of information service “leskosmos” (Forest - UA) as a segment of National program GEOUA
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The system of information service called Forest-UA is created in territory of Ukraine. Forest-UA System is a wood segment of GEOUA National program.

publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology

articleTitle: Multimedia data transmission system for 10.15-12.50 GHz band
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Universal wireless digital system (UWDS) is considered and developed by Beta TV com Ltd. It is intended for organization of digital TV broadcast within the wireless broadcasting speed telecommunications network. The higher speed (4-5 bit/s/Hz) has been achieved than in the system (1-2 bit/s/Hz) described in [1]. The system operates in Ku-range (10,15-12,5 MHz), and the transmission channels are formed using standard technologies. UWDS was manufactured and passed certification tests, that confirm its operating characters.

articleTitle: Hardness of microwave module to neutron irradiation
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Neutron irradiation effects in microwave modules are investigated. Main reasons of parameter degradation are discussed.

articleTitle: Integrated former of high-speed data traffic and tv for radio links digital updating
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology

articleTitle: FET stability criteria dependences calculation at influence of video and radio pressure impulses
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of influence video- and radio impulses of the pressure leading thermal breakdown research on field transistors Shottki are resulted. Device life time dependences on a drain pressure are received.

articleTitle: The diagnostics of heteroepitaxial structures GaAs/AlGaAs/GaAs based on technique of selective etching
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The technique of level-by-level etching of heterostructures GaAs/AlGaAs/GaAs with use of selective etchants is developed. Typical nomograms for definition of thickness of layers of a structure and also the estimation of electrophysical parameters of two-dimension electron gas are executed.

articleTitle: The influence of circularly polarized microwave irradiation on properties of plasma membrane of human cells
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The effects of differently polarized microwaves (f=35 GHz, E = 30 muW/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, irradiation time 10 s) on human buccal epithelium cells were investigated. The stainability of cells with indigo carmine (5 mM) or trypan blue (0.5 %) after 5 min of staining was investigated. Irradiation induced decrease of percentage of unstained cells. As a rule the left polarized radiation induced more expressed effect than right polarized radiation and linearly polarized radiation induced the most effect.

articleTitle: Investigation of electromagnetic properties of water at weak level of MM range signals
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: It is investigated the interaction of electromagnetic radiation of mm range (52 GHz) with different water samples. It is shown that various prepared water samples have different radiative and absorption capacity.

articleTitle: The method of measurements and dielectric parameters of the film materials at MM-wave range
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: For the MM and SubMM ranges, on the base of high-Q Fabry-Perot resonator the original method of dielectric parameters measurements of thin film materials (<lambda/2) which does not need the information about film thickness, is presented. The dielectric parameters of popular film materials like Teflon (PTFE), lavsan, Polyethylenterephthalat (PTFE) are presented. The essential difference of dielectric parameters of film and ldquobulkrdquo Teflon was found.

articleTitle: Resonant method for measurement of complex permittivity of wine
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The method of the capillary-waveguide resonance for measurement of dielectric characteristics of wine over the range of frequencies 54 -78 GHz was used. The influence of concentrations of alcohol in wine on frequency, Q-factor and depth of the energy absorption at resonance was investigated.

articleTitle: Electrodynamic descriptions of the irregular open waveguide with the mirrors phase correction
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology

Problems of possibility of creation on the basis of such systems ultrahigh frequency range selective devices and electromagnetic waves amplifiers are discussed.

articleTitle: Electron drift velocity control in transistor structure based on GaAs quantum wire
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The Monte-Carlo simulation of electron transport in GaAs-in-Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> quantum wire transistor structure is performed with account of electron scattering by the localized acoustic and polar optical phonons and surface roughness. The dependencies of electron drift velocity on the longitudinal electric field strength at 77 and 300 K are calculated. The possibility of electron drift velocity control via the variation of the gate potentials leading to change in electron scattering rates is investigated.

articleTitle: Nonlinear dynamics of electrons in a pump magnetic field of a free electron maser
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: We showed that in the vicinity of the magnetoresonance (the undulator frequency is close to the cyclotron one), one can efficiently transfer kinetic energy of longitudinal constant motion of an electron to its transversal-oscillatory degrees of freedom, thus providing for a successful amplification of a seed microwave. An analytical condition of the dynamics chaos onset caused by coupling between electron undulations and cyclotron rotation in the pump magnetic field is presented; Lyapunov exponent maps are built. The closed non-involutive set of first integrals is found. Using Nehoroshev theorem, it is determined that the dimension of invariant tori is 2. We establish that interaction between an electron beam and microwave does not lead to a noticeable broadening of the dynamics chaos zone, if this interaction is sufficiently small.

articleTitle: Butler matrices for 4-8 GHz band
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: 4times4 and 8times8 Butler matrices operating within frequency band 4-8 GHz are designed and fabricated. The simple and reliable designs of wideband Butler matrices are proposed which have high electrical performances reproducible by mass production.

articleTitle: Calculation method for loop-type phase shifters at coupled transmission lines
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology

publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology

articleTitle: Transceiver for half-duplex communications
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology

articleTitle: The approaches for extended personal services estimation
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The approach to finding the engineering-and-economical performance of personality-user services in 3/4G networks. The criteria of engineering-and-economical reasonability of such services providing is suggested.

articleTitle: Problems of the multipositioned signal optimal receiving in CDMA systems
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: General types of CDMA systems, transmission environment distortion, transmission path modeling, and receiving challenges are described.

articleTitle: Model of the crystal of microcircuits for research of strained current and thermal modes
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Electrothermal model of a crystal of the modern microcircuits is presented, considering many-layer of metallizing process, discharge circuits are considered at influence on microcircuits of pulse electromagnetic fields, threshold values of firmness of microcircuits are calculated.

articleTitle: Adjustable oscillator on Gunn dioe of 5-mm range
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Modern approaches for theoretical analysis of Gunn diode voltage controlled oscillators (VCO) are discussed in this report in the wide frequency band. The design and technological problems for VCO operation mode optimization and new experimental data are described. As a result of the research fulfilled, Gunn oscillators are developed with frequency adjustment by the varicap supply circuit intended for operation in FM short-range radar ensuring the improved metering and operation performance.VCO theoretical simulation is performed using the special software for UHF devices on PC. Simulation results demonstrate a possibility of VCO of 5-mm range implementation on the basis of GaAs Gunn diodes and varicaps. Using the computer simulation results the VCO operating models are created with the following parameters: (i) operating wavelength range - (4 - 6) mm; (ii) frequency electrical adjustment range - more than 3 GHz; (iii) output power inside the electrical adjustment range - more than 10 mW. (iv) slope overfall for frequency adjustment at each models does not exceed 3 times. The operating speed of frequency electrical adjustment is investigated. The maximal measured speed is more than 50 times 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sup> Hz\sec.

articleTitle: Influence of a pulse field desynchronization in output plane of TEM horn antenna on its energetic directivity factor
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The simplified analytical model of TEM horn antenna is offered, allowing to find a pulse field in a distant zone and to write down expressions for energetic directivity factor (EDF).

articleTitle: Research of non-thermal macrowave energy infuence upon yeast cultures
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Problems of non-thermal influence upon yeast cultures are considered. The working out of an experimental waveguide apparatus is defined below and presented results of experimental study.

articleTitle: Electrically small antennas for rocket-space and aviation technics
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of researches and designing of electrically small antennas for a rocket-space and aviation technics are presented and the method of improvement of their input characteristics is offered.

articleTitle: Application of microstrip photonic crystals to measurement of parameters of materials
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Computer simulation and experimental investigation of transmission spectra of microstrip photonic crystals have been performed in the frequency band from 0 till 6 GHz. Good coincidence of the calculation results with experiment has been obtained. The possibility to use the microstrip photonic crystals for implementation of the method of measurement of parameters of materials has been shown.

articleTitle: Potential and rotational Space-charge fields In a free electron maser
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Simulation of periodic signal amplification regime in a free-electron maser (FEM) is carried out taking into account the space-charge field. We study influence both of the potential and rotational space-charge fields. An approximate method of calculation of the rotational part of the space-charge field is proposed. Its idea lies in approximation of an infinite set of rotational cutoff modes by some quasi-static electric and magnetic fields. We determine that the rotational part of the space-charge field suppresses the defocusing influence of the potential part on electron beam bunching.

articleTitle: Synthesis of barium-strontium titanate films by sol-gel method
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The precursor solution with Ba and Sr (60/40) was prepared by sol-gel synthesis using titanium alkoxides. articleTitle: The design features of middle-power, low-loss, L-band circulators
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology

articleTitle: The OFDM use for the fight against the frequency-selective fading in radio-relay links
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology

publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology

articleTitle: About constructive influence of noise on secure communication

articleTitle: Phase noise characteristics of MSSW tunable oscillators
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The phase noise characteristics of magnetostatic surface wave (MSSW) delay lines oscillators were investigated using pure YIG films. The oscillator consisted of narrow band MSSW delay line in a feedback loop around on amplifier. It was noticed that the white noise spectral density was a function of the incident power to the devise. An explanation of the powers dependence will be given.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the Schottky barrier parameters in the micron-size metal-semiconductor contacts
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: We show that under certain conditions the submillimeter wave detector response of a Schottky barrier diode is a linear function of applied bias and allows evaluating the barrier height and the near-surface doping level of semiconductor in the micron-size Schottky barrier contacts.

articleTitle: Influence of the field amplitude distribution in the antenna aperture on its statistical radiation characteristics
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The investigation of average radiation patterns caused by influence of atmospheric turbulence presented in the form of Gaussian models is carried out for the aperture antennas.

articleTitle: Contactless methods of eyes pathology diagnostics with use of optical diapason radiation
publicationTitle: 2008 18th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of use of electromagnetic radiation of optical diapason for diagnostics of structurally functional abnormalities and intraocular pressure pathology is given.
